Miraikan Assist App vulnerable to cross-site scripting
Overview
Miraikan Assist App provided by Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) contains the following vulnerability.
Cross-site scripting (CWE-79) - CVE-2026-73537
RyotaK of GMO Flatt Security Inc. reported this vulnerability to the developer and coordinated. After the coordination was completed, RyotaK reported the case to JPCERT/CC to notify users of the solution through JVN.

Affected Products
Japan Science and Technology Agency
Miraikan Assist App Android version (versions prior to 1.1.7)
Miraikan Assist App iOS version (versions prior to 1.0.7)
Impact
An arbitrary script may be executed in the browser component (WebView) running on the affected product, resulting in the displayed content being altered.
Solution
[Update the Application]
Update the application to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
